recommendation: Keep the commit. It is a narrow core-source correction that completes FHIR-51699 while preserving the later Devices WG naming and leaving unresolved extension-pack/THO work to their own tickets.
issue_request: FHIR-51699 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 DeviceAlert vocabulary cleanup: keep DeviceAlert vocabulary URLs in the correct canonical form, make statuses active, use the Devices WG publisher/contact metadata, and correct the misspelling of annunciated.
initial_application: Upstream commit 5a348482d4/PR #3629 applied most of the request: DeviceAlert CodeSystems were made active and assigned WG publisher/contact metadata, ValueSets were made active, activationState spelling was corrected, DeviceAlert contact was updated, and core CodeSystem URLs were intentionally left without /CodeSystem after the #committers discussion. The application missed most DeviceAlert ValueSet publisher/contact metadata.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active DeviceAlert resource entry and the current dev WG entry uses the name Devices. FHIR-55949 later confirms the old Health Care Devices name should be updated to Devices. FHIR-51952 is an unresolved FHIR-extensions follow-up and FHIR-53238 is a Resolved - change required THO migration, so neither removes the need to fix current core source metadata.
reconciliation: Updated all ten source/devicealert/valueset-devicealert-*.xml files to use publisher "HL7 International / Devices" and contact URL "http://www.hl7.org/Special/committees/healthcaredevices". No CodeSystem URL changes were made.

related_jiras.note: Applied issue establishing the current Devices WG name, used to choose "HL7 International / Devices" rather than restoring the older Health Care Devices publisher wording.

Resolved - change required proposal to move several DeviceAlert terminology artifacts to THO; not Applied/Published, so it was context only.
